prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1136; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left. Complaints centered on neck pain and stiffness consistent with cervical strain. The mechanism and force of the impact appear well matched to the injury described. Over the course of sixteen visits, care included manual therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and a home stretching program. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency and intensity reducing steadily as symptoms resolved and mobility returned. On examination, reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness support the reported injury, while neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical spine or surrounding soft tissues is known to this provider. Separately, the billing records show two similar charges entered on the same day, which are currently under review for accuracy. Based on current findings, the patient is expected to reach full recovery with continued home exercise and periodic reassessment as needed.
